blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Pet owners and animal lovers brought their furry companions to the Sto. Niño Cathedral on Sunday, Oct. 4, to mark the Feast of St. Francis of Assisi, the patron saint of animals, nature and ecology. The celebration, held as part of the Catholic Church’s Season of Creation, began with an 8 a.m. Mass at the cathedral grounds, followed by the traditional blessing of pets. Dogs, cats and other companion animals joined their owners in the gathering, which emphasized gratitude for the diversity of life and the responsibility to care for God’s creation.
